propositions: Static startup config and auth bindings must be composed once when MCP/review-bot services start and remain immutable across ambient environment/file mutations until process restart.
Inbound MCP bearer tokens must remain request-scoped context and never appear in startup snapshots, operation snapshots, serialization, logs, caches, or child environments.
Decision-bearing auth (Gerrit, GitHub, LLM credentials) must be validated before accepting jobs/webhooks, with no principal fallback on missing/revoked/conflicting auth.
Each operation/request must compose a fresh OperationSnapshot with per-operation non-secret config while retaining the startup-bound static policy.
Partial or rejected telemetry credentials (Langfuse/OTLP) must disable telemetry without changing the underlying operation result, while security-critical auth remains fail-closed.
Static binding replacement is observed only after process restart/redeploy; native SDK-owned refreshable capabilities are exempt from this constraint.
